title: Degree-zero compatibility of derived base change and the ordinary counit mate
statement: Choose shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category] for all schemes. Let f:X\to S, g:S\prime\to S, g\prime:X\prime\to X, f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in X.Modules and X\prime.Modules. Let M be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], R^0f_*M invertible and R^qf_*M zero for q>0 [def-pc-invertible-in-degree-zero]. Put E=M[0], H=H^0, and let c:g\prime^*f^*\cong f\prime^*g^* be the pullback composition comparison [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist isomorphisms a:g^*f_*M\cong H(Lg^*Rf_*E) and b:H(Rf\prime_*Lg\prime^*E)\cong f\prime_*g\prime^*M such that the ordinary mate [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] of c^{-1} followed by g\prime^* of the counit equals a.hom followed by H of the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by b.hom. This assertion does not assume or conclude invertibility of a base-change map.

proof.text: Construct the pinned single-module pullback comparisons and apply their invertibility theorem to M and N=f_*M. The given invertibility of R^0f_*M transports to N through rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf.

Positive vanishing makes the constructed single-module direct-image unit u_f(M) invertible. Let a be the single-complex H^0 comparison inverted, followed by H^0 of p_g(N) inverted and then H^0 of Lg*(u_f(M)). Let b be H^0 of Rf′_*(p_g′(M)) followed by the canonical H^0 direct-image isomorphism.

Apply canonicalDegreeZeroMateSquare to sq.w. Precompose the desired equality with H^0(p_g(N)) followed by the single-complex homology identification. This composite is invertible. Cancel it, and simplify functoriality and inverse identities to obtain the stated equality.

theorem counitBaseChange_degreeZero_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules]
    (M : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} M]
    (h0 : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u}
      (((pushforward f).rightDerived 0).obj M))
    (hq : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero (((pushforward f).rightDerived q).obj M)) :
    let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let c := (pullbackComp g' f).app ((pushforward f).obj M) ≪≫
      (pullbackCongr sq.w).app ((pushforward f).obj M) ≪≫
      ((pullbackComp f' g).app ((pushforward f).obj M)).symm
    ∃ (a : (pullback g).obj ((pushforward f).obj M) ≅
        H.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)))
      (b : H.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj ((derivedPullback g').obj E)) ≅
        (pushforward f').obj ((pullback g').obj M)),
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').homEquiv _ _
          (c.inv ≫ (pullback g').map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M)) =
        a.hom ≫ H.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E) ≫ b.hom
